vivid-sound.settings.title: Vivid Sound Settings
vivid-sound.settings.search_hint: Search sound events (e.g. cow, block, ambient):
vivid-sound.settings.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, no sound text is rendered on screen.
vivid-sound.settings.followScreen.toolti: When on, sounds behind you are pinned to the screen edge. When off, off-screen sounds are hidden.
vivid-sound.settings.subtitleOnly.toolti: When on, only sounds that have a vanilla subtitle are shown (filters out raw sound paths).
vivid-sound.settings.size.tooltip: Global scale multiplier for all sound text on screen.
vivid-sound.settings.duration.tooltip: How long (in seconds) each sound caption stays on screen before fading out.
vivid-sound.settings.maxDistance.tooltip: Sounds farther than this distance (in blocks) are not shown.
vivid-sound.settings.frequency.tooltip: Minimum interval (seconds) between on-screen indicators for the same sound. Set to 0 to show every occurrence.
vivid-sound.settings.font.tooltip: Font used for sound captions. Put .ttf/.otf files in config/vivid-sound/fonts/ and click Reload.
vivid-sound.settings.font_reload.tooltip: Re-scan the fonts folder for newly added font files.
